baseline: Current shared workspace, 2026-11-20; command-only implementation, no TUI page changes.
scope: 定义并接入命令式的人类引导流程：选择观测块、人工标注、绑定规则/目标、只读预览、明确启用及查看结果；复用同一 --json 服务输出。
acceptance: 流程不要求先写 hook 或改训练循环即可完成标注和只读预览。
每步显示锚点、语义、覆盖与后果；penalty 变更目标前需要明确命令/确认。
失效绑定、无法执行和 stale 规则给出可操作修复提示；JSON 稳定区分错误和覆盖状态。
仅命令接口/帮助，不修改 TUI 页面或现有 TUI owned files。
implementation: Added `m-model model supervise guide`: resolves explicit or project-default model/batch, runs a real Probe, lists only observed module/port candidates, asks the user to choose and manually author role/meaning, persists a source-anchored mark, adds one observe/require/penalty rule, and runs a read-only preview. Displays source file/hash, current-call coverage, violations and later training consequence. Rules never activate implicitly; managed/manual try/train require explicit `--apply-supervision`. JSON/no-interactive mode returns `GUIDED_FLOW_REQUIRES_TTY` with exact scripted alternatives. Existing mark/rule/preview services are reused. 引导支持 batch-alignment：用户选 require/observe 后手动填写批次 Tensor 路径和轴；预览显示目标路径及模型/目标形状，不声称标签值正确。 For finite/range, the shared CLI also accepts a user-selected --axis and can preview current-batch violations against declared stable IDs in envelope metadata; managed/manual require failures include violating IDs before updates. Top-level coverage remains partial, IDs are user-asserted, and multi-batch completeness is not inferred. 外部循环可选择 --apply-supervision，并需遵守 context.supervised_step(batch)、context.backward(loss)、context.register_optimizer(optimizer) 协议；普通外部循环保持用户自有逻辑，未登记的 optimizer 更新不被计入监督。
